text: Three games. Three better habits. ♟️ Give your next chess break a purpose. Game 1: before you move, name your opponent’s threat. Game 2: after each capture, check what can be taken back. Game 3: before trading pieces, compare king safety. Try this in free AI practice inside Web3Chess. Then open Challenges to see the tasks you completed and claim any earned XP. You can explore XP rewards and Mystery Boxes in the Marketplace; check each box’s cost and rewards in the app. Save this training card, or pass it to a friend for their next chess break. Tap below to open the app, then choose free AI practice in Play.
